# Test fixtures

## `autzen_trim.laz`

- **Source:** [PDAL test corpus](https://github.com/PDAL/PDAL/blob/master/test/data/laz/autzen_trim.laz)
- **Origin:** A trimmed subset of the well-known *Autzen Stadium* LiDAR scan (Eugene, Oregon), captured by Watershed Sciences and widely redistributed as a community reference dataset.
- **License:** PDAL is BSD 3-Clause; the autzen scan itself is publicly redistributed for testing under permissive terms by Watershed Sciences. We use this file solely as test input to drive the LAZ reader.
- **Size:** 603,353 bytes
- **SHA-256:** `75867b3e75cfc3c2e96da9f753c04c9fbaa6a59468dea13e2859f3109b38bd66`

If the licensing situation needs further attribution, please open an issue.
